_meta.description: Dotted capital-letter sigle of two or three letters that are not the initials of a person (P.Q.M., C.T.U., D.L.). initials() never replaces them.
_meta.frequency: Found in at least 3 documents (three letters) or 100 (two letters) of 4,800 civil merito judgments sampled from the 2019-2026 yearly archives; their parties are written Parte_1 or M___, never as initials, so nearly every dotted token there is a sigla. Two-letter sigle need the higher bar because two letters are also the commonest initials of a person.
_meta.additions: Sigle of penal, administrative and tax practice that those judgments do not use (P.G., G.U.P., C.P.P., D.N.A., A.F., D.P.), added by hand when a false positive showed one missing.
_meta.normalization: Upper-case letters with their dots, one entry per sigla, sorted by length and then alphabetically.
